Final library quality was determined using the Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Kit.

Following Gel Beads-in-emulsion (GEMs) generation, cell lysis and dissolution of the Gel Bead within each reaction vesicle enabled reverse transcription of polyadenylated mRNA, producing cDNA tagged with both a universal cell barcode and unique molecular index (UMI). The reaction vesicles were then lysed for cDNA amplification followed by purification using Dynabeads MyOne SILANE magnetic beads. Quantification of cDNA was performed using Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Kit (Agilent Technologies, CA, USA). The generated cDNA from each sample was used for 5’ gene expression (5'GEX) scRNA-seq library generation. Enzymatic fragmentation of the cDNA transcripts was carried out, followed by End-Repair and A-tailing, adaptor ligation and final library amplification PCR with unique sample indices for each sample. Final library quality was determined using the Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA Kit.

description: Blood sample taken at one timepoint from CS3392
data_processing: The reads were demultiplexed and aligned against the GRCh38 reference genome using 10X Cell Ranger v6.0.1 (10X Genomics, CA, USA). The single-cell data were loaded into count matrices, and all 10 samples were merged using Seurat v4.1.

A total of 94,947 cells, which had less than 20% of transcripts mapping to mitochondrial genes and expressed at least 500 genes were retained for scaling, log-normalization of gene expression measurements, and principal component analysis with the top 2,000 genes selected by variance stabilizing transformation approach as implemented by Seurat, in addition to the 14 mitochondrial/rRNA genes (MT-ND1, MT-ND2, MT-CO1, MT-CO2, MT-ATP8, MT-ATP6, MT-CO3, MT-ND3, MT-ND4L, MT-ND4, MT-ND5, MT-ND6, MT-CYB, and RN7SL832P) that were removed from the dataset using our in-house annotated blacklist genes.
UMAP was used to visualize the distribution of cells in the projection of the significant principal components, and cell type annotation was accomplished with known markers from each cell type.
Up-regulated genes from each group were used for gene enrichment analysis with Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process using enrichR.
To explore the effect of rituximab treatment, all six longitudinal PBMC samples from Twin-CS were merged and analyzed.
